300 Palestinian children killed in 300 days. That's[ one child killed on
average every day](https://www.unicef.org/press-releases/least-300-children-
reportedly-killed-gaza-past-300-days) by Israel since the so-called
"ceasefire" took effect last October, according to UNICEF. As we've asked over
and over again: What ceasefire?

What ceasefire, when Israel kills over[ 30
Palestinians](https://www.dropsitenews.com/p/iran-us-trump-talks-gaza-israel-
strikes-deal-cuba-electricity-blackout) in the days _after_ U.S. President
Donald Trump claims a breakthrough in talks to implement the truce.
